name: report-problem
description: reportProblem saves what an assistant writes about a tool that misbehaved, for the user to send from the options page; the add-on sends nothing. A saveDraft call that fails (a draftId that names no draft) is followed by a report that names saveDraft: the report is saved (saved true, sent false, one waiting) and the result holds its link as a new GitHub issue for the user to open, the file commonpost-mcp-reports.json of the profile holds it with the versions the add-on added and the error saveDraft had just returned, and the mail address written in the details is replaced. The same report a second time, a tool name that is not a tool of the server and a summary over 120 characters are refused, and a suggestion without a tool is saved as the second report. Nothing is sent through SMTP. Not covered: the options page (its list, the prefilled GitHub issue, Copy, Delete), which no MCP call reaches, and the limit of 20 waiting reports.

steps.note: An error of saveDraft for the add-on to remember.
